description: List ideas in a workspace, filterable by status. Returns short ids so you can follow up with get_idea on a specific one. Statuses are backlog (not started yet), active and closed; the older names draft and open also work. Default: active.

limit.description: Number of ideas per page (1-50). Default: 10.

status.description: Filter by status: backlog, active or closed. Default: active.

name: list_ideas
